description:
About Extend:

Extend is revolutionizing the post-purchase experience for retailers and their customers by providing merchants with AI-driven solutions that enhance customer satisfaction and drive revenue growth. Our comprehensive platform offers automated customer service handling, seamless returns/exchange management, end-to-end automated fulfillment, and product protection and shipping protection alongside Extend's best-in-class fraud detection. By integrating leading-edge technology with exceptional customer service, Extend empowers businesses to build trust and loyalty among consumers while reducing costs and increasing profits.

Today, Extend works with more than 1,000 leading merchant partners across industries, including fashion/apparel, cosmetics, furniture, jewelry, consumer electronics, auto parts, sports and fitness, and much more. Extend is backed by some of the most prominent technology investors in the industry, and our headquarters is in downtown San Francisco.

About the Role

The AI Enablement team gives every team at Extend the AI tooling it needs to do its best work. We pair directly with business users in finance, support, claims, sales, recruiting, and operations to understand how they work, then build the agents, connectors, and skills that change it. This is an engineering role first. Sitting beside a business user is how you find the right problem. Solving it takes real engineering judgment about agent harnesses, protocols, security, and reliability.

You will build on the platform that turns one-off prototypes into durable, secure, measurable tooling: MCP connectors to the systems we run on, agent-to-agent (A2A) integrations, a shared library of agent skills, and the evaluation practice that tells us whether any of it actually works.

What You'll Do

  • Pair with business users to run workflow analysis and process mapping, find the highest-leverage problems, and turn ambiguous requests into scoped technical plans.
  • Design and ship secure MCP connectors to Extend's internal systems and third-party SaaS: finance, CRM, data warehouse, expense management, product analytics, support, ATS, and the long tail beyond.
  • Build agent-to-agent integrations using A2A and similar protocols, so specialized agents can delegate to each other safely across domains.
  • Choose and configure the right agent harness or orchestrator for each job, and build multi-agent patterns (planner/executor, specialized sub-agents) where they genuinely help.
  • Stand up Extend's evaluation practice for agents and skills: golden datasets, regression suites, LLM-as-judge, tracing, and drift detection. Every shipped skill should have a way to prove it works and to notice when it stops working.
  • Build and curate the shared library of agent skills every team composes from. Codify patterns and raise the floor for what a safe, high-quality skill looks like. Treat every engagement as a source of reusable skills and connectors.
  • Design credential scoping and vending for agent connectors: per-user, per-skill, per-connector keys, OAuth/OIDC where it fits, least-privilege everywhere.
  • Build the risk-tier and review model for shared skills, including sandboxing and dependency scanning for skills that pull in untrusted packages. Partner with legal, security, and privacy on governance review for agents that touch sensitive data or take autonomous actions.
  • Instrument the platform end to end with OpenTelemetry so every MCP call, skill execution, and credential use is visible in Coralogix.
  • Own adoption. Write self-serve guides, onboard teams, and run the feedback loop between what shipped and what users actually need. The work is done when the team using it is self-sufficient.
  • Mentor more junior engineers on the team in evals, agent design, and secure integration work.

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years shipping production systems, and you can point to where they held, where they broke, and what you changed.
  • Proficient in TypeScript/Node, Python, or Rust.
  • Hands-on experience building with MCP and at least one agent framework or harness (Claude Code, OpenAI Agents SDK, LangChain/LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, Google ADK). Familiarity with A2A or other agent interoperability protocols.
  • Experience designing and running evals for LLM or agent systems, and using the results to make shipping decisions.
  • You can build real third-party integrations: OAuth flows, credential scoping, webhooks, pagination, rate limiting, retries.
  • You've built developer tooling, platforms, or internal tools that other people depended on, and you measure that work by adoption.
  • You can work directly with non-technical stakeholders: run a working session, challenge assumptions constructively, and explain trade-offs in plain language.
  • Comfortable on AWS (Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB, S3) with solid security fundamentals: IAM, KMS, serverless attack patterns.
  • Familiarity with AI governance and legal or privacy review processes, including risks around data access, permissions, tool use, and autonomous actions.
  • You use AI tooling every day and have opinions about what works.

Nice to Have

  • Eval and observability tooling: LangSmith, Langfuse, Braintrust, OpenTelemetry, Coralogix, Datadog.
  • LLM application security: OWASP Top 10 for LLMs and agentic applications, prompt injection defense, agent sandboxing.
  • AWS CDK, CloudFormation, or similar infrastructure-as-code.
  • Background in platform engineering, internal developer platforms, or enterprise integration.
  • Prior IC role at an early-stage startup with a small team and a wide surface area.
Expected Pay Range: $155,000 - $170,000 per year salaried*

* The target base salary range for this position is listed above. Individual salaries are determined based on a number of factors including, but not limited to, job-related knowledge, skills and experience.

Extend does not provide immigration-related sponsorship for this role. 

Life at Extend:

  • Working with a great team from diverse backgrounds in a collaborative and supportive environment.
  • Competitive salary based on experience, with full medical and dental & vision benefits.
  • Stock in an early-stage startup growing quickly.
  • Generous, flexible paid time off policy.
  • 401(k) with Financial Guidance from Morgan Stanley.
